name: Select
description: An accessible, styled dropdown component for selecting a single option from a list, with support for labels, placeholders, error states, helper text, and required/disabled states.
usage: `id` and `label` are optional: the id is generated, and without a visible label pass `aria-label`.
Pass an array of `SelectOption` objects to the `options` prop.
Controlled with `value` and the native `onChange(event)`, or uncontrolled with `defaultValue`.
An `error` shows at once; pass `touched` (the field's touched state) to hold it until the field is left. `touched={false}` hides it.
Provide `helperText` for additional context; while disabled, the helper shows instead of the error.
Customize styling with `className` (root) and `selectClassName` (select element), merged with cn.
Sizes: '2xs' | 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' (default) | 'lg'; compact is the deprecated alias for 'xs'.
design: Ensure the `label` clearly describes the purpose of the select.
Use `placeholder` text that guides the user (e.g., 'Select an option...').
Keep option `label` text concise and easy to understand.
Use `helperText` for supplementary information, not critical instructions.
Error messages should be specific and actionable.
Labels use `.type-label` (14px medium) for consistent form styling.
Helper text uses `.type-caption` which includes muted color semantically.
Error messages use `.type-body-sm` (14px) with error color override.

Size xs (and its deprecated alias compact) uses smaller typography: `.type-label-sm` (12px) for labels, `.type-caption` for errors, `.type-caption-compact` (10px) for helper text, and reduced padding.
One border colour per state: --color-border-subtle at rest, --color-error with an error, --color-border-emphasis while disabled; label and helper use --color-text-disabled while disabled
accessibility: Follows WAI-ARIA patterns for Combobox/Listbox where applicable to native select.
Labels are correctly associated using `htmlFor` and `id`.
Error states are conveyed using `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby`.
Disabled state prevents interaction and is visually distinct.
Option descriptions are available via the `title` attribute on hover/focus.
Inline mode uses `aria-label` to maintain accessibility when visible label is hidden.
Focus shows on any focus (focus:ring-1 primary; error: --color-error), as for every text field

props.name: id
props.description: The select's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label (a <label for>; in inline mode, the select's aria-label). Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled: the chosen value. Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled: the value chosen at first

props.name: onChange
props.description: The native change event, in both modes

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; shown unless touched is false or the field is disabled. Sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby

props.name: helperText
props.description: Optional helper text shown below the select.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root (merged with cn)

props.name: selectClassName
props.description: Classes for the select (merged with cn; the app's class wins a conflict)

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show error at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left (false hides it)

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text shown when no value is selected.

props.name: size
props.description: Height, padding and type from the input size scale (utils/inputSizing)

props.name: compact
props.description: Deprecated: use size="xs". size wins when both are given

props.name: inline
props.description: Inline mode: hides the visible label (it becomes the select's aria-label; an app's aria-label wins) and lays the root out inline. Use for horizontal flows like '[20 ▼] per page'.

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, onBlur, autoFocus…) goes to the select; an aria-describedby is kept beside the helper or error id
